Read a cached extract, if there is a usable one

Source: R/diff-cache.R
diff_cache_read.Rd

Read a cached extract, if there is a usable one

Usage

diff_cache_read(entry)

Arguments

entry

A cache entry directory, from diff_cache_entry()

Value

The path of the cached extract, or NULL if entry holds no complete cached run.

See also

Other cached pipeline runs: diff_cache_entry(), diff_cache_write(), diff_extract_subdir(), git_resolve_run_sha(), omop_es_run_cached()
